name: @brianjenkins94/observability
description: The observability plane: @brianjenkins94/util/logger spans/records carried over @brianjenkins94/hub. A source-scoped relay publishes each LogRecord onto its hub on $sys.log.<source>; a root collector renders the merged, span-nested, cross-context stream. The reusable middle layer between hub (routing) and a sink like debug-mcp (a Node collector + MCP).
